name: origin-ai-workspace
description: A modern self-hosted AI workspace for developers, students, NAS users, and personal workflows.

scripts.dev:api: sh -c 'if [ -x apps/api/.venv/bin/python ]; then exec apps/api/.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --app-dir apps/api; else echo "Create apps/api/.venv first: python3 -m venv apps/api/.venv && apps/api/.venv/bin/pip install -e \"apps/api[dev]\""; exit 1; fi'
scripts.test:api: sh -c 'if [ -x apps/api/.venv/bin/pytest ]; then exec apps/api/.venv/bin/pytest apps/api/tests/ -v; else echo "Install dev deps first"; exit 1; fi'
scripts.api:migrate: sh -c 'if [ -x apps/api/.venv/bin/alembic ]; then exec apps/api/.venv/bin/alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head; else echo "Create apps/api/.venv first: python3 -m venv apps/api/.venv && apps/api/.venv/bin/pip install -e \"apps/api[dev]\""; exit 1; fi'
